description: This file defines the class GitBuildVersionGenerator, which generates version information based on Git history. It includes methods to retrieve version code and name, and uses a nested object for executing Git commands.

classes.name: GitBuildVersionGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates version information based on Git repository data, including revision count and tags, with configurable offsets.

classes.name: ProcessOutput
classes.description: An interface for executing commands and retrieving their output.

methods.name: isValidForEnvironment
methods.description: Checks if the Git repository has any commits, indicating a valid environment.

methods.name: getVersionCode
methods.description: Calculates a version code based on Git revision count, tags, and an offset.

methods.name: getVersionName
methods.description: Generates a version name string based on provided generation data, applying a patch offset.

methods.name: getGitHistorySize
methods.description: Returns the number of commits in the Git history, or -1 if an error occurs.
